435 changes

# Unmeasured behavior changes

* [Toolkit edits need a bench proof sized by task class](2026-10-24-toolkit-edits-need-a-bench-proof-sized-by-task.md) - it gates the ledger and dotfiles commits on this machine, which no work intake reads; the ledger itself shows whether change files carry proof
* [The metrics switch reads only the environment variable](2026-10-24-the-metrics-switch-reads-only-the-environment.md) - The change decides only whether metrics rows are written, not what any agent does. The intake's toolkit-telemetry line reads the switch on each pull.
* [Escape loggers file false or stale prose as docs](2026-10-24-escape-loggers-file-false-or-stale-prose-as-docs.md) - The before period has almost no docs escapes because the skills never offered the class, so a before-and-after watch on the class reads a false rise. Read it as a share: once about 40 new review escapes have landed, count the docs share of review escapes and compare it with the census share of false or stale prose.
* [The code reviewer checks every prose claim against the code](2026-10-24-the-code-reviewer-checks-every-prose-claim-against.md) - Until this date the escape skills never offered the docs class, so the logged class has no before period for false or stale prose. From this date they file it as docs. Read it once about 40 new review escapes have landed: the docs share of review escapes against the census share of 13 percent.
* [Toolkit scripts sorted into code, review, gates, telemetry, lib and tools folders](2026-10-24-toolkit-scripts-sorted-into-code-review-gates.md) - A pure move. Every hook command, import and printed text keeps its behavior, so no intake number moves. The gain is finding a script by concern, which no stream counts.
* [Build the design now covers module splits and folder layout](2026-10-24-build-the-design-now-covers-module-splits-and.md) - No intake stream records a deferred structure choice. The user reads it in session reports.
* [Split code_step into four modules; hand-backs read from the event log](2026-10-24-split-code-step-into-four-modules-hand-backs-read.md) - The change keeps every verb, route and printed ACTION text. The cut branches had no sighting in any session, so no intake number reads them. The gain it aims at is fewer code-step fix lanes, which no intake stream counts.
* [Toolkit Python follows PEP 8 names and a full ruff rule set](2026-10-24-toolkit-python-follows-pep-8-names-and-a-full-ruff.md) - A rename and lint sweep changes no number that the intake reads. Hook ids in stderr and log rows keep the kebab-case form.
* [The user never waits on tests or lint](2026-10-24-the-user-never-waits-on-tests-or-lint.md) - No work-log field records how long the user waited on a test or lint run that the agent handed over.
* [The worktree rule names tuios beside herdr](2026-10-24-the-worktree-rule-names-tuios-beside-herdr.md) - No work-log field records which route opened a worktree.
* [Review asks carry the finding id the logger printed](2026-10-24-review-asks-carry-the-finding-id-the-logger.md) - No work-log field counts ask outcome rows that found their ask row against the ones that did not.
* [The /code skill passes a closing skill only with no open finding](2026-10-24-the-code-skill-passes-a-closing-skill-only-with-no.md) - No work-log field records a closing skill's open findings next to the skill-done verdict.
* [One resume verb for every /code run that stopped](2026-10-24-one-resume-verb-for-every-code-run-that-stopped.md) - No work-log field records which code-step verb a /code run used, or a run that went to the wrong step after a stop.

# 2026-10-27

* [Shell gates cover subagents, coder new files and stdin code; quoted redirects stop counting](2026-10-27-shell-gates-cover-subagents-coder-new-files-and.md) - shell-write-gate now holds subagents and coders to the redirect and in-place rules with no skip comment, denies a coder's new file outside the temp roots, and stops reading a quoted `>` or `2>&1` as a write; the interpreter hint denies code fed on stdin; the pipe-to-shell check ignores a quoted `|` and sees through wrappers.
* [code_step test pins a review-loop hand-back that lands after the wait-cap stop](2026-10-27-code-step-test-pins-a-review-loop-hand-back-that.md) - A test replays the LED-10 run: the fork's SendMessage to a review-loop is queued before the wait-cap stop, the loop hands back after it, and `resume` takes that hand-back instead of asking the user.
* [quality-check-cap allows one rerun redirected to a file after a run cut by tail, head or grep](2026-10-27-quality-check-cap-allows-one-rerun-redirected-to-a.md) - When a check's last run was piped through tail, head or grep, the cap allows one rerun with its output sent to a file, and the deny names that exact form.
* [Skills and scripts never need the ledger to finish; verify-branch falls back on any unread ledger](2026-10-27-skills-and-scripts-never-need-the-ledger-to-finish.md) - New rule in toolkit-script-rules.md: no skill, agent or script needs the ledger to finish. verify_common now treats a missing or failing ledger like a busy one, so verify-prep and verify-log fall back to the checkout's own record of the logged review.
* [A review-loop's cap-exit coder no longer marks its hand-back unreviewed](2026-10-27-a-review-loop-s-cap-exit-coder-no-longer-marks-its.md) - The hand-back hook demanded a reviewer after a review-loop's last coder, but the loop's own cap exit dispatches none after its round-2 coder, so every loop whose second review filed a fix ended stop-no-reviewer; from round 2 on, one reviewer dispatch by the loop now suffices.

# 2026-10-26

* [Telemetry loggers print their usage on --help instead of refusing it as a malformed argument](2026-10-26-telemetry-loggers-print-their-usage-on-help.md) - `log-escape --help` and `log-spec-run --help` refused the flag as a malformed key=value pair, so the four loggers and log-escape-check in telemetry/, and the four review scripts, now print their header usage block on --help or -h, exit 0 and write no row.
* [branch-recap reads the deferred queue through a script that waits out a cache behind](2026-10-26-branch-recap-reads-the-deferred-queue-through-a.md) - branch-recap Step 2 runs scripts/tools/ledger_deferred.py, which waits the shared 90 s for a ledger that is behind and otherwise prints deferred: not read with the command to run, never an empty queue.
* [A busy ledger read waits about 90 s before it gives up](2026-10-26-a-busy-ledger-read-waits-about-90-s-before-it.md) - script_utils.read_ledger retries a ledger read that exits 75 for up to LEDGER_WAIT_SECONDS = 90 (8 tries, 84 s of pauses), and verify_common and the branch-recap deferred read both go through it in place of their own retry loops.
* [parallel_tests kills a test file past its time limit](2026-10-26-parallel-tests-kills-a-test-file-past-its-time.md) - The suite runner kills a test file's process group after 1200 s (TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) and reports that file as failed by name, so one hung file no longer stalls tests/run.sh.
* [matches_no_test leaves a runner piped into another command unjudged](2026-10-26-matches-no-test-leaves-a-runner-piped-into-another.md) - A test runner whose output feeds a later pipe stage (`cargo test <filter> 2>&1 | rg -q ...`) is no longer judged as matching no test; the last stage owns the output and the exit code.
* [code skill reads say.md and question.md only when present](2026-10-26-code-skill-reads-say-md-and-question-md-only-when.md) - The code skill's hand-back step reads say.md and question.md only when each exists and is not empty.
* [code_step writes question.md on every stop on an agent's report or silence](2026-10-26-code-step-writes-question-md-on-every-stop-on-an.md) - Every /code stop on an agent's report or silence (no agent id, wait cap, coder stop, critical blocker, review cap, failed closing check) writes question.md with why, one line per open item and the exact command to go on; `skill-done fail` takes `--finding`.
* [code_step resume routes a late review hand-back on its report](2026-10-26-code-step-resume-routes-a-late-review-hand-back-on.md) - After a wait-cap stop, `resume` routes a review-loop report that arrived late on that report, and the stale "never handed back" question is replaced.
* [code_step says the plan-rewrite coder's open choices to the user](2026-10-26-code-step-says-the-plan-rewrite-coder-s-open.md) - The plan-rewrite coder may not ask the user; it ends its report with one `OPEN CHOICE:` line per choice the ruling leaves open, and `after-plan-edit` says each one to the user.
* [gate env takes a run's values from its own plan alone](2026-10-26-gate-env-takes-a-run-s-values-from-its-own-plan.md) - `repo_gate_env` returns only the run's own plan's `NAME=value` words when that plan is readable; values other plans agree on now fill in only for a run with no plan.
* [code_step commit list keeps a dirty-before file the phase edited](2026-10-26-code-step-commit-list-keeps-a-dirty-before-file.md) - The phase commit command now names a file that was dirty before the phase when the phase changed its content, and the hand-back flags it as mixing earlier edits; dirty files the phase left alone stay out.
* [code_step verification refusal names the phase and offers only a repo script](2026-10-26-code-step-verification-refusal-names-the-phase-and.md) - The refusal for a compound Automated Verification line names the phase each bad line belongs to, says every open phase is checked at each start, and offers only an executable repo script whose comments name no ticket or plan path.
* [code_step phase start carries trailing text to the coder as run notes](2026-10-26-code-step-phase-start-carries-trailing-text-to-the.md) - Text after `<plan> --phase <id>` (or `Phase <id>`) reaches the coder brief as run notes, `start --help` matches the parser, and a closing phase stops on notes it cannot pass on.
* [code_step start --restart drops the old run before any check that can stop it](2026-10-26-code-step-start-restart-drops-the-old-run-before.md) - `start --restart` drops the old run before the gate and phase checks, so a start they stop leaves no open run for the next `start` to refuse.
* [code_step start lets the same session replace its stopped run and prints a restart form it accepts](2026-10-26-code-step-start-lets-the-same-session-replace-its.md) - A run that stopped on the coder's report no longer blocks the same session's next `start`, and the open-run refusal prints a `--restart` command the script accepts.
* [code_step start reads task text from a file](2026-10-26-code-step-start-reads-task-text-from-a-file.md) - `code_step.py start --task-file <path>` reads the task text verbatim from any path, the code skill passes it through, and a positional non-plan file outside the repo is refused with the --task-file command.
* [herdr-worktree fork starts the forked session on a hand-over brief](2026-10-26-herdr-worktree-fork-starts-the-forked-session-on-a.md) - herdr-worktree --fork now takes a required --prompt that the forked Claude session starts on, and the orchestration rule says to pass a brief naming the task, what is done, the next step and that the fork owns the work.
* [verify-prep and verify-log go on when the ledger stays busy](2026-10-26-verify-prep-and-verify-log-go-on-when-the-ledger.md) - A ledger that stays busy or behind no longer stops /verify-branch: the retries wait about a minute, the message names the wait and the ledger's own line, and a review that verify-log logged from this checkout for the same tree stands in for the ledger's answer.
* [Phase commit uses the plan's named commit line, never a none summary](2026-10-26-phase-commit-uses-the-plan-s-named-commit-line.md) - code_step's phase commit takes its subject from the phase's Commit `...` line in the plan when there is one; otherwise from the coder's Implemented summary, unless that summary starts with none, when it takes the phase title.
* [Criteria dry-run leaves closing-phase items to their skill, as the plan check does](2026-10-26-criteria-dry-run-leaves-closing-phase-items-to.md) - criteria_dry_run.py skips the Automated Verification items of closing phases (Refactor pass, Test audit, Verify pass, Recap), which their skill checks from the session's evidence and never runs, so it no longer reports them UNPARSED while the plan check passes them.
* [An ask outcome keeps the finding id of the ask row the loop logged](2026-10-26-an-ask-outcome-keeps-the-finding-id-of-the-ask-row.md) - The review-loop stop hook pairs each ask row the loop logged with the finding id the log helper printed; review_fix.py and code_step.py fill each packet ask from those rows, or log the ask row themselves, so every ask outcome supersedes its ask row instead of landing under a new id.
* [Test-audit rows carry their lane, a test file:line or unlocated, and a measured diff size](2026-10-26-test-audit-rows-carry-their-lane-a-test-file-line.md) - A /fix started by a test audit passes lane test-audit to its review-loop, whose metrics and run rows now carry it; log-review-finding measures diff_loc from diff_base=<ref> to the working tree, takes file=unlocated, and refuses a test-intent-reviewer finding with no file or line 0.
* [eng-spec plan repairs ask architects for section text, not file edits](2026-10-26-eng-spec-plan-repairs-ask-architects-for-section.md) - When a design gap or a plan-review finding goes back to an architect, eng-spec now asks for the full text of each changed section and writes it into the plan files itself, because architects hold no Edit or Write tool.
* [A review-loop waiting on its own background agent is not a missing hand-back](2026-10-26-a-review-loop-waiting-on-its-own-background-agent.md) - review_loop_gate.py records each review-loop stop with its count of open background agents; review_fix.py packet prints wait-for-loop, not stop-no-handback, while the loop waits, so /review and /fix no longer re-dispatch a second loop onto files the first loop's coder still edits.
* [A hand-back gate timeout is reported as a timeout, not a failing suite](2026-10-26-a-hand-back-gate-timeout-is-reported-as-a-timeout.md) - coder_gate.py records a command that hits its timeout apart from failures, lets the hand-back through stamped with the timeout and no test result, and code_step reports it as timed out; a new test covers the listed cargo commands on the --phase start path.
* [A review-loop hand-back with no reviewer run cannot turn the review gate clean](2026-10-26-a-review-loop-hand-back-with-no-reviewer-run.md) - handback.py records the coder and reviewer dispatches each review-loop makes, and refuses a clean hand-back when no reviewer ran after the loop's last code change; +fast now only changes the reviewer model.
* [code_step keeps the ask-fix coder's behavior off the phase Implemented line](2026-10-26-code-step-keeps-the-ask-fix-coder-s-behavior-off.md) - An ask-fix coder BEHAVIOR line shows as its own Ask-fix line in say.md, not on the phase Implemented line or Behavior delta.
* [code_step carries a plan-impact round's other asks and pending findings](2026-10-26-code-step-carries-a-plan-impact-round-s-other-asks.md) - After a plan-impact review round, its other asks and pending findings go to the user and into the next review handoff.
* [Review-loop stop hook blocks a packet with unlogged finding rows or a plan-file edit](2026-10-26-review-loop-stop-hook-blocks-a-packet-with.md) - The review-loop stop check blocks once when the packet lists findings with no per-finding ledger rows or no metrics line, or names the plan file in files_touched.
* [review-scope stops when no base is found and the branch has commits of its own](2026-10-26-review-scope-stops-when-no-base-is-found-and-the.md) - review-scope exits 3 with a clear message instead of printing a working-tree-only scope when no base ref exists and the branch holds commits no other ref has.
* [A search line behind a leading cd is judged as a search ban](2026-10-26-a-search-line-behind-a-leading-cd-is-judged-as-a.md) - A verification line whose rg or grep command starts with cd <dir> && is a search ban like a bare one, so exit 1 with no match passes.
* [The plan check fails a criterion that drifted from the ticket](2026-10-26-the-plan-check-fails-a-criterion-that-drifted-from.md) - The eng-spec plan check fails a ticket Acceptance line whose text no AC in the criteria file carries and no sign-off names; a ticket with no Acceptance or Requirements heading is skipped.
* [Test runner inside a command substitution is not judged no-test-matched](2026-10-26-test-runner-inside-a-command-substitution-is-not.md) - A test runner inside $(...) or backticks is not judged no-test-matched, because the outer command's output does not carry its report.
* [rg/grep presence check no longer read as a ban](2026-10-26-rg-grep-presence-check-no-longer-read-as-a-ban.md) - An rg or grep Automated Verification line stays a ban unless its text says it checks presence; then exit 0 passes.
* [A cargo test name after option flags reads as a filtered run](2026-10-26-a-cargo-test-name-after-option-flags-reads-as-a.md) - A cargo test command is filtered when a bare name follows its options, or any token follows --, so a name that matches no test reads RED in the eng-spec dry run and the code-phase verification.
* [Plan-review rounds write reviewer reports to files; round two checks them](2026-10-26-plan-review-rounds-write-reviewer-reports-to-files.md) - Each plan-review round writes every reviewer report to the task directory, and a script check fails round two when a prior round's report file is missing.
* [The /code fork runs as an agent with no Edit or Write tool](2026-10-26-the-code-fork-runs-as-an-agent-with-no-edit-or.md) - The /code skill forks into a new code-fork agent that has no Edit, Write or NotebookEdit tool, so the fork can no longer implement a brief itself and skip the coder gate and review loop.
* [code_step counts the hand-back cap from the agent's launch](2026-10-26-code-step-counts-the-hand-back-cap-from-the-agent.md) - The /code wait cap starts at the Agent call's launch, not at the printed dispatch, so a worker that holds a dispatch no longer gets a false has-not-handed-back stop.
* [The turn-end formatter skips plan files](2026-10-26-the-turn-end-formatter-skips-plan-files.md) - format_changed.py no longer runs prettier or oxfmt on files under docs/plans/, so a plan's next Edit and its review shards still match the text on disk.
* [quality-check-cap skips help probes and allows a for-loop repeat](2026-10-26-quality-check-cap-skips-help-probes-and-allows-a.md) - The cap no longer counts a --help/-h/--version/-V call as a check run, and it allows a check repeated in one for loop over two or more values, so a flake check runs the same command N times without flag dodges.
* [skill-done pass writes each closing-phase box with its evidence](2026-10-26-skill-done-pass-writes-each-closing-phase-box-with.md) - code_step.py skill-done pass now needs one --evidence per open Success Criteria item in a closing phase; it ticks each box and writes a Done line under it, so refactor and test-audit results reach the plan.
* [asks-done records whether the user or the session ruled](2026-10-26-asks-done-records-whether-the-user-or-the-session.md) - The asks-done verb of review_fix.py and code_step.py takes --by user|session, each ask outcome row carries ask_decided_by, and the ask prompts tell the session to rule itself when the repo's CLAUDE.md hands it ask decisions.
* [code-step abort verb ends an open /code run](2026-10-26-code-step-abort-verb-ends-an-open-code-run.md) - code_step.py abort drops the open /code run: it archives state.json, clears the say, question and coder-gate files, and prints what it dropped, so the next start begins a fresh run with no restart flag.
* [The hand-back gate runs the cargo commands a phase lists](2026-10-26-the-hand-back-gate-runs-the-cargo-commands-a-phase.md) - When a plan phase lists cargo commands under Automated Verification, code_step.py start sets the hand-back gate to those commands in place of crate-wide clippy and the cargo test commands it derives from the phase's files.
* [Code phase verification fails a filtered test run that matches no test](2026-10-26-code-phase-verification-fails-a-filtered-test-run.md) - code_step_boundary.run_verification_commands marks a filtered test command that exits 0 and reports no passed test as failed, with the zero-test check criteria_dry_run.py already used, now shared from lib/test_run_output.py; mocha and bun summaries now count as passed tests.
* [code-step start and adr prep take long task text on Python before 3.14](2026-10-26-code-step-start-and-adr-prep-take-long-task-text.md) - code_step.py and adr_flow.py test argument words with os.path instead of pathlib, so a task text longer than a file name no longer crashes start with OSError File name too long on Python 3.13 and older.
* [Split command steps keeps a quoted operator in its step](2026-10-26-split-command-steps-keeps-a-quoted-operator-in-its.md) - A quoted |, &&, || or ; stays inside its step, so a search pattern that names a check tool is no longer read as a run of it.
* [A filtered test run that matches no test reads RED in the eng-spec dry run](2026-10-26-a-filtered-test-run-that-matches-no-test-reads-red.md) - The dry-run script marks a filtered test run RED unless the output reports at least one passed test.
* [The eng-spec dry run checks every phase and flags broken count and pgrep criteria](2026-10-26-the-eng-spec-dry-run-checks-every-phase-and-flags.md) - A new script runs every Automated Verification command of every phase and flags a self-matching pgrep -f and a count that differs from the plan's own code.
* [Ruled /code asks reach later review and refactor passes](2026-10-26-ruled-code-asks-reach-later-review-and-refactor.md) - asks-done and pre-set ask outcomes are saved in the code-step state directory, and later review hand-offs and the closing refactor prompt list them so a matching finding is dropped instead of raised again.
* [A /code phase stays open when its review loop did not converge](2026-10-26-a-code-phase-stays-open-when-its-review-loop-did.md) - code-step records how each review loop ended and, when it did not converge, leaves the phase open, commits nothing, records no reviewed-tree fingerprint and says what the run waits on.

# 2026-10-25

* [Review commit gate credits merges, user-ordered commits, reviewed trees and the repo a commit runs in](2026-10-25-review-commit-gate-credits-merges-user-ordered.md) - A dirty session now commits a merge, a commit the user ordered with a [no-review] prompt, a tree a converged review covered, and judges git -C commits by the target repo.
* [A grep or rg ban holds when the search finds nothing](2026-10-25-a-grep-or-rg-ban-holds-when-the-search-finds.md) - A plan ban written as a bare rg or grep command exits 1 when it finds nothing, which code-step read as a failed command and stopped the run. Such bans are now judged by match, like a git grep ban.
* [Scope boxes diff recorded commits, not a branch name](2026-10-25-scope-boxes-diff-recorded-commits-not-a-branch.md) - A plan box that diffs main...HEAD reads nothing once the branch merges, so a box ticked after merge passed with nothing checked. plan check now fails such a box and the closing-phase text names the form that survives merge and fails when empty.
* [eng-spec plan check fails an AC id that names a different criterion](2026-10-25-eng-spec-plan-check-fails-an-ac-id-that-names-a.md) - The spec is written before the criteria file, so its bare AC numbers carried the ticket's numbering while the criteria file numbered its own. plan check now fails a bare AC reference in spec.md that is not that criterion's id.
* [Quality-check cap lets a scoped cargo test run](2026-10-25-quality-check-cap-lets-a-scoped-cargo-test-run.md) - The quality-check cap no longer denies a repeat of a cargo test scoped to a named lib, doc, test target, bin or filter; the unscoped run stays capped.
* [Review ask outcomes with no finding id are logged under a new id](2026-10-25-review-ask-outcomes-with-no-finding-id-are-logged.md) - When a review-loop hands back an ask with no valid finding_id, review_fix.py asks-done and code-step now log the user's answer under a new id instead of dropping it.
* [Deny bare rg with no path before it hangs on stdin](2026-10-25-deny-bare-rg-with-no-path-before-it-hangs-on-stdin.md) - A Bash call of rg with no path, alone or first in a pipeline, is denied with the same command plus a dot, so the search runs in a second instead of hanging until the timeout.
* [bash-safety-gate pipe-to-shell rule reads real pipes only](2026-10-25-bash-safety-gate-pipe-to-shell-rule-reads-real.md) - The pipe-to-shell rule no longer denies a pipe character inside a quoted argument, such as the regex (py|sh).
* [Give spec-research and spec-criteria the Edit tool](2026-10-25-give-spec-research-and-spec-criteria-the-edit-tool.md) - Agents that write a file they may later correct now have Edit, so a blocked sed -i no longer pushes them to an inline Python rewrite.
* [The main-branch guard in the bash safety hook reads only each push command's own arguments](2026-10-25-the-main-branch-guard-in-the-bash-safety-hook.md) - The main-branch guard no longer denies a chained command that holds push and a main or master word in different commands.
* [Wrapped shell block names the direct form](2026-10-25-wrapped-shell-block-names-the-direct-form.md) - The deny text for a wrapped shell command now tells the agent to run the inner command directly as its own Bash call.
* [Credential and review-commit blocks tell the agent to carry on](2026-10-25-credential-and-review-commit-blocks-tell-the-agent.md) - The review commit gate and the credential-read blocks now tell the agent to continue the task, so a main-session turn no longer ends on the block.
* [The review logger saves a dirty reviewed tree as a commit](2026-10-25-the-review-logger-saves-a-dirty-reviewed-tree-as-a.md) - A review row logged on a dirty tree now carries snapshot, a commit on HEAD of the tree the gate saw, kept under refs/review-snapshots/<id>, so the frozen review set can use the dirty rows it used to drop.
* [Global rule: tell the user about a toolkit bug or inefficiency, then queue it in agent-evals](2026-10-25-global-rule-tell-the-user-about-a-toolkit-bug-or.md) - The global CLAUDE.md gains a section: a session that notices a toolkit bug or inefficiency tells the user first, then adds an agent-evals queue item, with no work content on the work machine.
* [The review loop drops the fix-diff verification pass](2026-10-25-the-review-loop-drops-the-fix-diff-verification.md) - Step 5d is gone: no reviewer reads a fix diff that no full review follows, the execution gate is its only read, the loop gate no longer blocks on an unread fix diff, and a review-loop fix finding defers only as an open class member.
* [code-step start takes a phase named after the plan, and the refactor skill shows a log input that parses](2026-10-25-code-step-start-takes-a-phase-named-after-the-plan.md) - `code_step.py start <plan> Phase <id>` and `start <plan> <id>` start that phase where they used to stop on 'text after the plan', and the /refactor skill shows a JSON log input that `refactor_flow.py log` accepts, so two first calls that callers got wrong daily now pass.
* [The /code question for the user outlives the Stop hook, and resume takes the user's answer](2026-10-25-the-code-question-for-the-user-outlives-the-stop.md) - code_step.py writes every ask-user question to question.md, which the Stop say-hook never empties, and `resume <answer>` at a stopped coder puts the answer in that question instead of refusing it, so a /code run that stops for the user no longer hands back an empty question.
* [Review-flow scripts: every function under complexity 10, dead CLI surface cut](2026-10-25-review-flow-scripts-every-function-under.md) - review_fix, handback, review_loop_gate and review_commit_gate hold no function over C901 10 and tests/run.sh fails on one; the hand-back latest verb, kind inference, the --check dry run, the Task tool name and the unused packet keys are gone.
* [Refactor branch sweep reads the diff through the shared parser](2026-10-25-refactor-branch-sweep-reads-the-diff-through-the.md) - refactor_flow's sweep for markers and commented-out code now reads the branch diff with lib/source_text.parse_unified_diff, not its own line walker, so a line that holds a form feed or a lone carriage return is swept whole.
* [Global rule: cap test workers and run one heavy job at a time](2026-10-25-global-rule-cap-test-workers-and-run-one-heavy-job.md) - The global CLAUDE.md gains a Machine Load section: cap test-runner workers at 2 in the repo config, run one heavy job at a time, check free memory first, and read the kernel log after a crash.
* [The dotfiles suite fails when ruff is missing](2026-10-25-the-dotfiles-suite-fails-when-ruff-is-missing.md) - tests/run.sh stops with exit 1 and an install line when ruff is not on PATH, where it used to print 'lint skipped' and pass, so a lint or complexity defect can no longer ship through a suite run on a machine without ruff.
* [Code-step tests jump through a fake nvim-jump, never the user's Neovim](2026-10-25-code-step-tests-jump-through-a-fake-nvim-jump.md) - code_step.py present_asks reads the nvim-jump command from CODE_STEP_NVIM_JUMP, like review_fix.py's REVIEW_FIX_NVIM_JUMP, and the code-step tests set it to a fake, so a test run no longer opens its temp files in the user's Neovim.
* [Code-step wait tests set their own cap so suite load cannot reach it](2026-10-25-code-step-wait-tests-set-their-own-cap-so-suite.md) - The code-step hand-back cap now reads an optional CODE_STEP_WAIT_MULTIPLE, which defaults to the same three waits; the tests that expect a wait set it to 60, so a slow setup under suite load no longer turns their wait into a cap stop.
* [Toolkit script fixes: drop the dead hand-back gate, kill a timed-out coder check's process group, one plan-deviation format](2026-10-25-toolkit-script-fixes-drop-the-dead-hand-back-gate.md) - A coder-gate check that times out now kills its whole process group and reports what it printed; the unregistered review-loop hand-back gate is gone; code_step and review_fix write plan-impact rulings in one format.
* [Stale-prose and refactor scripts share the lib git runner and C-path decoder](2026-10-25-stale-prose-and-refactor-scripts-share-the-lib-git.md) - The stale-prose merge brought back a git_output copy and a second unquote_c_path, which the duplicate check failed on; stale_prose now runs git through script_utils.run_or_raise and refactor_flow decodes quoted paths through source_text.
* [/code review asks survive a new session and carry one proposed change](2026-10-25-code-review-asks-survive-a-new-session-and-carry.md) - A /code run now pins to the session that opens each dispatch, so open review asks and a review-again hand-back survive a new session; a resume at a closing phase re-invokes its skill; and every structured review ask carries one proposed change, so an accepted answer gives the asks coder an edit to make.
* [Git-only Bash hooks spawn only when the command names git or gh](2026-10-25-git-only-bash-hooks-spawn-only-when-the-command.md) - The git discipline gate, the review commit gate and the deferred push check now carry `if` filters on their PreToolUse Bash entries, so a Bash call that never mentions git or gh no longer spawns three Python processes. The filters start with a wildcard, because an anchored `Bash(git *)` let wrapped forms such as `env git commit` skip the gate.
* [Fail the toolkit test run on new duplicate code](2026-10-25-fail-the-toolkit-test-run-on-new-duplicate-code.md) - tests/run.sh now runs tests/duplicate_code.py, which fails when a toolkit script defines a top-level function name another script already defines, or when jscpd finds a new token clone; today's repeats sit in a baseline that may only shrink.
* [Remove every duplicate in the toolkit scripts; fail on any repeat](2026-10-25-remove-every-duplicate-in-the-toolkit-scripts-fail.md) - The duplicate check dropped its baseline and now fails on any repeated function name or jscpd clone; 29 repeated names and 14 clones moved into lib/script_utils.py and lib/hook_input.py or got names of their own.
* [Coder hand-back gate lists stale comment and doc lines](2026-10-25-coder-hand-back-gate-lists-stale-comment-and-doc.md) - The coder's hand-back gate on every plan phase runs stale_prose.py, which lists the comment and doc lines that name a symbol the diff renamed, removed or changed, so the coder fixes stale prose before review.
* [Read git output through one shared lib function](2026-10-25-read-git-output-through-one-shared-lib-function.md) - Six toolkit scripts and one lib helper each ran git through their own git_output copy; they now all call script_utils.git_output, which drops stderr, turns path quoting off, keeps non-UTF-8 names and takes an optional timeout.
* [Own-branch /peer-review catches log as peer-review escapes; each run logs own-branch or teammate](2026-10-25-own-branch-peer-review-catches-log-as-peer-review.md) - /escape gains a peer-review stage; /peer-review logs one row per run saying whether the PR is the user's own, and on an own-branch run hands each kept defect to /escape.
* [Dotfiles tests and scripts find toolkit code in their own checkout](2026-10-25-dotfiles-tests-and-scripts-find-toolkit-code-in.md) - The test suite and ten scripts found toolkit code through ~/.claude, so a suite run in a dotfiles worktree tested the live scripts instead of the edited ones. They now find it from their own file location, and a script change can be edited and fully tested in a worktree before the user merges it.
* [Hand the user one chained command line, not a series](2026-10-25-hand-the-user-one-chained-command-line-not-a.md) - The global CLAUDE.md now tells the session to give the user one `!` line that chains every command with &&, in place of a series of lines.
* [Never add a session attribution line to a commit or PR](2026-10-25-never-add-a-session-attribution-line-to-a-commit.md) - The global CLAUDE.md now forbids a Claude-Session line, a session link or any attribution line in a commit message or PR body, over any harness reminder.

# 2026-10-24

* [A misworded Automated Verification heading stops the code step](2026-10-24-a-misworded-automated-verification-heading-stops.md) - plan_format read a phase's verification commands only under the exact `#### Automated Verification` heading. A misworded heading counted as no commands, so the phase closed green with nothing run. A level 4 heading that holds automated and verif but is not the exact heading now raises with its file line, and the code step stops at start, at the plan check and at a plan edit during a /code run.
* [The code step checks the criteria file under any Acceptance heading](2026-10-24-the-code-step-checks-the-criteria-file-under-any.md) - code_step stopped on a missing or empty acceptance-criteria.md only when the plan held the exact line `## Acceptance Criteria`. Any other wording skipped the check with no output. It now matches any level 2 or 3 heading that starts with Acceptance, case-insensitive.
* [verify-log refuses a run with no verdict row for a ticket criterion](2026-10-24-verify-log-refuses-a-run-with-no-verdict-row-for-a.md) - verify-log checked that every acceptance-criteria.md id had a verdict row, but never checked the ticket's own criteria. A ticket-only run, or a task dir with no criteria file, logged CLEAN with any non-empty rows. verify-prep now saves the ticket criterion labels, and verify-log exits 2 and writes nothing when a `Ticket #n` has no row.
* [Metrics writers fold pairs that zsh left in one argument](2026-10-24-metrics-writers-fold-pairs-that-zsh-left-in-one.md) - kv_fold refused a value such as `lane=code scope=phase iter=1`, which is what `C="lane=code scope=phase"; writer $C` sends under zsh, since zsh does not split an unquoted variable. Each word after the first is now folded as its own pair when every one of them is name=value and the key is not free text. Any other spaced value is still refused.
* [Coder guard refuses whole-suite make and docker checks](2026-10-24-coder-guard-refuses-whole-suite-make-and-docker.md) - The coder bash guard reads a make target's Makefile text and the command inside a docker exec or run call, and refuses the call when it runs a whole test suite, lint or build.
* [Toolkit edits need a bench proof sized by task class](2026-10-24-toolkit-edits-need-a-bench-proof-sized-by-task.md) - From 2026-10-25 a change file's kind is fix, user-rule, structured or open; structured and open must cite findings with 8 or 32 runs per arm, and a dotfiles pre-commit hook refuses a toolkit commit with no change file.
* [The metrics switch reads only the environment variable](2026-10-24-the-metrics-switch-reads-only-the-environment.md) - The metrics writers log only when CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1. The file ~/.claude/toolkit-telemetry no longer turns logging on, and the ~/dev/evals/ folder check is gone because nothing else turns it on.
* [Push and PR open list unchanged deferred bug findings](2026-10-24-push-and-pr-open-list-unchanged-deferred-bug.md) - A PreToolUse hook on Bash lists the branch's deferred bug and correctness findings whose code has not changed since review, each time Claude runs git push or gh pr create. It adds context and never denies.
* [Review-loop runs its checks in the foreground](2026-10-24-review-loop-runs-its-checks-in-the-foreground.md) - The wait-loop hook now refuses every background job review-loop starts: run_in_background, a lone &, nohup, setsid and disown. The refusal tells it to run the same command in the foreground with a Bash timeout up to 600000 ms.
* [With no ledger on PATH the metrics writers append to the old jsonl files](2026-10-24-with-no-ledger-on-path-the-metrics-writers-append.md) - ledger-write exited 0 silently when the ledger binary was missing, so a machine with no ledger lost every review finding, review run, review metrics row, escape, spec run and scan run. It now appends the completed row to the jsonl file each type used before the ledger switch and prints one stderr line.
* [Escape loggers file false or stale prose as docs](2026-10-24-escape-loggers-file-false-or-stale-prose-as-docs.md) - The four skills that log escapes by hand name the `docs` class, and the two that log review comments say a false or stale comment, doc or description is `docs`, never `smell` or `other`. The logger already accepted `docs`; the skills never offered it.
* [The code reviewer checks every prose claim against the code](2026-10-24-the-code-reviewer-checks-every-prose-claim-against.md) - The code reviewer gains a prose-claims lens. Every comment, docstring, doc, ADR and run-time description that the diff adds, or that names something the diff changes, must hold for the code after the diff. A false or stale claim is a fix, never a smell or a nit.
* [Toolkit scripts sorted into code, review, gates, telemetry, lib and tools folders](2026-10-24-toolkit-scripts-sorted-into-code-review-gates.md) - The 52 flat scripts in ~/.claude/scripts moved into six folders by concern. Hook commands, imports and logic are unchanged; only paths changed.
* [Build the design now covers module splits and folder layout](2026-10-24-build-the-design-now-covers-module-splits-and.md) - The global rule against deferred design now names module splits and folder layout, and says small size is no reason to wait.
* [Split code_step into four modules; hand-backs read from the event log](2026-10-24-split-code-step-into-four-modules-hand-backs-read.md) - code-step reads every hand-back from one record with one match rule, its hooks no longer write the state file, four unused edge cases are gone, and no function in it is over complexity 10.
* [code-step and coder-gate write their state files atomically](2026-10-24-code-step-and-coder-gate-write-their-state-files.md) - save_state and both coder-gate writers write a temp file in the same folder and then replace the target, so a reader that polls during a wait never sees a half-written file.
* [Toolkit Python follows PEP 8 names and a full ruff rule set](2026-10-24-toolkit-python-follows-pep-8-names-and-a-full-ruff.md) - The 28 kebab-case toolkit scripts get snake_case file names, camelCase identifiers become snake_case, and ruff lints E,W,F,I,N,B,UP,SIM,C4,RUF at 120 columns on every suite run.
* [The user never waits on tests or lint](2026-10-24-the-user-never-waits-on-tests-or-lint.md) - The global quality-checks block now says the agent runs the full suite and lint on the files an install command writes before it hands that command over, and the command only writes files.
* [The worktree rule names tuios beside herdr](2026-10-24-the-worktree-rule-names-tuios-beside-herdr.md) - The worktree line in orchestration.md now sends a session inside tuios to `herdr-worktree --fork`, the same as inside herdr. tuios sets `HERDR_ENV` too.
* [Review asks carry the finding id the logger printed](2026-10-24-review-asks-carry-the-finding-id-the-logger.md) - The ledger writer switch changed the review text: each ask in the review-loop packet carries the `finding_id` that log-review-finding printed, the ask outcome supersedes the ask row by that id, and `desc=` is no longer stored.
* [The /code skill passes a closing skill only with no open finding](2026-10-24-the-code-skill-passes-a-closing-skill-only-with-no.md) - The /code skill's invoke-skill step now says which verdict to send: `skill-done pass` only when the closing skill reports no open finding, else `skill-done fail`. Before, it named both and gave no rule.
* [One resume verb for every /code run that stopped](2026-10-24-one-resume-verb-for-every-code-run-that-stopped.md) - `code-step.py resume` replaces `continue`, `after-coder`, `after-review` and `after-plan-edit` as the one way to go on with a stopped /code run. `start` refuses over an open run and names `resume` or `start --restart`. Six stop routes that no run reached are cut, and the /code skill runs `resume` for empty task text.
* [A resumed /code run reaches the right next step](2026-10-24-a-resumed-code-run-reaches-the-right-next-step.md) - Five code-step defects that sent a stopped or resumed /code run to the wrong step: a resumed coder at the wait cap, `start after-review` over an open run, a phase given inside task text, a plan-edit coder at the cap, and a review-loop hand-back from an agent the run did not launch.

# 2026-10-23

* [The test suite lints the toolkit Python](2026-10-23-the-test-suite-lints-the-toolkit-python.md) - `tests/run.sh` runs ruff over the toolkit scripts and their tests before the test run. An unused import, an unused variable or an undefined name fails the suite. A report of functions over complexity 10 prints but does not fail. Five files lose an unused import.
* [Script rules: cap edge-case code and script size](2026-10-23-script-rules-cap-edge-case-code-and-script-size.md) - The toolkit script rules no longer ask for a route and a test for every change that can happen during a run. Only reported changes get a route, and the rest go to one fallback stop. A new Size section asks for a sighting before new code, reuse of shared helpers, a split before features in a script over 1000 lines, and a stop when a diff is more than twice its design estimate.
* [A dirty commit is denied with a /review reason instead of a prompt](2026-10-23-a-dirty-commit-is-denied-with-a-review-reason.md) - `review-commit-gate` denies a `git commit` while coder work from the session has no converged review. The reason tells the session to run /review and commit after it converges. A docs-only commit chain that ends in `git rev-parse` now passes. An internal error in the gate still asks.
* [/code continue resumes the saved plan](2026-10-23-code-continue-resumes-the-saved-plan.md) - `/code continue` (or `/code` with no text) now runs `code-step.py start` with no argument, which resumes the saved plan. Before, the skill passed the word to `start` as task text, and code-step began a planless run that dropped the plan, left the phase unticked and cut files from the commit.
* [The hand-back check runs with the plan's gate variables](2026-10-23-the-hand-back-check-runs-with-the-plan-s-gate.md) - code-step reads the `NAME=value` words that the plan's verification commands start with, plus the repo's gate variables, and stores them in the gate with `coder-gate.py set --env`. The hand-back hook runs every check with them, so it sees the same settings as the coder's own run.
* [code-step runs scoped Rust tests and refuses checks that never end](2026-10-23-code-step-runs-scoped-rust-tests-and-refuses.md) - For a Rust phase, the hand-back check runs only the test targets that hold the changed files (the lib, a bin or one test file), not every target in the workspace. A verification item that never ends (`tail -f`, `watch`, `sleep`, an editor, `claude`) or a bare word that is not a program is refused when the plan is written. A plan can mark an item CI-verified or human-only, and code-step does not run it.
* [Test writers and reviewers look across the whole suite for a test that already catches the bug](2026-10-23-test-writers-and-reviewers-look-across-the-whole.md) - The coder, both test reviewers and the plan format treat any test in the suite, at any layer, as a sibling. A rule's case table is tested at one layer, with one wiring test per other entry point.
* [Sign-offs record who and when, not the user's words](2026-10-23-sign-offs-record-who-and-when-not-the-user-s-words.md) - A sign-off that overrides a ticket criterion or moves a phase now records who signed off and when. It no longer quotes the user.
* [Plan-format and verify-branch text match the new gate, moved-phase and verdict-row rules](2026-10-23-plan-format-and-verify-branch-text-match-the-new.md) - The shared plan format says that /code stops at an open gated phase and documents the `[-]` moved-phase mark. The verify-branch skill says that verify-log exits 2 when a criterion id has no row.

# 2026-10-22

* [The review-loop stop gate ignores package and project flag values when it judges a scoped run](2026-10-22-the-review-loop-stop-gate-ignores-package-and.md) - review-loop-gate.py no longer reads the value of a package, project or manifest flag as a test filter, so `cargo test -p core` counts as a full gate run. The script also carries a hand-back check that is not registered in settings.json.
* [code-step logs an ask outcome only for a minted finding id](2026-10-22-code-step-logs-an-ask-outcome-only-for-a-minted.md) - code-step's ask-outcome logger now uses handback.ask_finding_id, as review-fix does. It skips and names a placeholder id, and it names a logger failure on stderr.
* [code-step reads a start argument with whitespace as task text](2026-10-22-code-step-reads-a-start-argument-with-whitespace.md) - `start` no longer treats a word with whitespace as a plan path, unless that word is an existing file. Task text that names a file path now starts a task run.
* [A no-op asks coder ticks the phase when it names where each ask is done](2026-10-22-a-no-op-asks-coder-ticks-the-phase-when-it-names.md) - When the asks coder changes nothing, code-step now runs the phase's verification commands and ticks, if the report has one `ALREADY-DONE: <n> — <file:line>` line for every accepted ask and raises no blocker. Every other no-change report still stops.
* [verify-branch retries a busy ledger before it reads the review state](2026-10-22-verify-branch-retries-a-busy-ledger-before-it.md) - verify_common.review_ran runs `ledger yield --review-trees` with a 60 s timeout and up to 4 tries when the ledger exits 75 (busy). If the ledger stays busy, it fails with a message that says to run the step again.
* [verify-log writes nothing when a criterion id has no verdict row](2026-10-22-verify-log-writes-nothing-when-a-criterion-id-has.md) - verify-log now exits 2, names the criterion ids with no verdict row and writes no rows. Before, it logged each absent id as a `missing` gap.
* [code-step start stops at an open gated phase](2026-10-22-code-step-start-stops-at-an-open-gated-phase.md) - When an open phase with a gate clause comes before the next ungated phase, `start` now stops and starts nothing. Before, it skipped the gated phases and started a later one.
* [A plan phase can be marked moved to another ticket](2026-10-22-a-plan-phase-can-be-marked-moved-to-another-ticket.md) - The plan grammar accepts `- [-] Phase <id>: … moved to <KEY>` with a Plan Deviations line that records the move. code-step never runs a moved phase, and verify-branch lists it as moved, not as done or missing.
* [Let a dirty session commit docs-only changes without asking](2026-10-22-let-a-dirty-session-commit-docs-only-changes.md) - review-commit-gate.py no longer asks the user when a dirty session commits only docs/**.md files, and it now asks for git commit forms it used to miss.
* [Do not count a gate run that a signal or an interrupt ended](2026-10-22-do-not-count-a-gate-run-that-a-signal-or-an.md) - quality-check-cap.py no longer records a failed Bash run that the user interrupted or that a signal ended (exit 129 to 192, timeout kills included), so the cap allows the rerun.
* [Skip ask outcomes whose finding id is a placeholder](2026-10-22-skip-ask-outcomes-whose-finding-id-is-a.md) - review-fix.py asks-done now logs an ask outcome only when its finding_id has the minted shape. A placeholder such as "none logged" is skipped and named, and the command no longer fails.

# 2026-10-21

* [Name the review-loop gate log by branch](2026-10-21-name-the-review-loop-gate-log-by-branch.md) - The review loop's full gate run now writes to /tmp/review-gate-<branch>.log, not one shared /tmp/review-gate.log that other sessions overwrite.
* [Goal-blind researcher waits for each child](2026-10-21-goal-blind-researcher-waits-for-each-child.md) - The goal-blind researcher now waits for each child's completion notice and checks for the file it writes before the next step. It never ends its turn while a child runs.
* [Retire the spec criteria lint](2026-10-21-retire-the-spec-criteria-lint.md) - The eng-spec finalization step no longer runs spec-criteria-lint.sh, and the script is deleted. Its one check, verification paths that no phase creates, was wrong on every report it made.
* [code-step logs each dispatch to an event log and denies a coder launch without its packet](2026-10-21-code-step-logs-each-dispatch-to-an-event-log-and.md) - code-step writes each dispatch, launch, resume and hand-back to one event log per run, saves each dispatch prompt to a file that ends in a marker line, and a new PreToolUse hook denies a launch whose prompt does not hold the whole saved prompt.
* [Script tests run with one fixed git config so CI and local agree](2026-10-21-script-tests-run-with-one-fixed-git-config-so-ci.md) - The script test runner gives every test process one fixed global git config, no system config, empty ignore and attributes files, and no git config from the environment. The CI workflow loses its own git setup step.
* [The code skill runs each code-step verb alone so the coder prompt is not cut](2026-10-21-the-code-skill-runs-each-code-step-verb-alone-so.md) - The /code skill tells the subagent to run each code-step.py verb as its own Bash call, with no pipe, head, sed or second command. A cut output loses the coder prompt.
* [Criteria parser skips a bold AC id inside a note but still refuses a miswritten criterion line](2026-10-21-criteria-parser-skips-a-bold-ac-id-inside-a-note.md) - verify_common.criteria_file no longer refuses an acceptance-criteria file because a note line has an unclosed bold **ACn's ... mid-line. A line that starts with a bold id, or holds a closed bold id span anywhere, and does not match `- **ACn** — text` still fails.
* [code-step says when a phase lists no verification commands and drops (last phase) when gated phases remain](2026-10-21-code-step-says-when-a-phase-lists-no-verification.md) - When a phase lists no verification commands, the phase-done text says that none were run, not "0 command(s) green". The Phase N complete line leaves out "(last phase)" when only gated phases remain. after-review and the handback hook share one helper that puts a resumed review loop back.
* [A refactor or review finding can log a file path that holds spaces](2026-10-21-a-refactor-or-review-finding-can-log-a-file-path.md) - refactor-flow.py log, log-escape and log-review-finding accept a file= value with spaces. All three refuse a file= value that holds a line break, or whitespace followed by name=, which is the shape of a swallowed key=value pair.
* [Format hook skips formatting while a git merge, cherry-pick, revert or rebase is unfinished](2026-10-21-format-hook-skips-formatting-while-a-git-merge.md) - The Stop step of format-changed.py formats nothing while the git dir holds MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD, rebase-merge, rebase-apply, SQUASH_MSG or MERGE_MSG. Files that a merge brings in are no longer reformatted before the merge commit.
* [Toolkit telemetry stays off in eval run trees unless a run turns it on](2026-10-21-toolkit-telemetry-stays-off-in-eval-run-trees.md) - The telemetry switch is off for a session whose project folder is inside ~/dev/evals/, unless CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1. CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=0 turns it off everywhere, even when the switch file exists. Eval runs no longer write test rows into the live logs.
* [code-step waits for a resumed agent, needs a dispatch time, and skips gated phases](2026-10-21-code-step-waits-for-a-resumed-agent-needs-a.md) - code-step waits for the hand-back of the coder or review loop of this phase, including one resumed by SendMessage. It stops when a state has no dispatch time, instead of reading an earlier row. start skips an open phase whose status line has a gate clause, and names it.
* [code-step runs env-prefixed checks, clippy for Rust phases, and commits a plan edited before the phase](2026-10-21-code-step-runs-env-prefixed-checks-clippy-for-rust.md) - code-step reads a verification command with leading NAME=value assignments and runs it with them set. A phase that touches Rust code gets a clippy gate. The phase commit includes the plan when the phase ticked it, even if the plan had edits before the phase. coder-packet no longer reads Phase 6.1 as Phase 6. One plan parser and one stage-guard table replace the duplicates.
* [The repeat-check cap counts each agent's own runs and trusts a formatter only before a sure check](2026-10-21-the-repeat-check-cap-counts-each-agent-s-own-runs.md) - The repeat-check cap keeps a separate record for each subagent, so a reviewer or the review loop gets its own first run of a check. A formatter exempts a check only when the check surely runs after the formatter succeeds.
* [The comment-bloat gate checks only files inside a git repo](2026-10-21-the-comment-bloat-gate-checks-only-files-inside-a.md) - The comment-bloat gate blocks a write only when the file resolves into a git work tree. Scratch files, probes and temp scripts outside a repo are not committed code, and the gate blocked them.
* [code-step stops when it cannot read a phase's checks](2026-10-21-code-step-stops-when-it-cannot-read-a-phase-s.md) - code-step marked a phase done after running none of its Automated Verification checks when it could not read them as commands. It did not know `cargo`, so every Rust phase skipped its tests. It now reads more command forms and stops when an item stays unreadable. The same batch fixes how it joins coder reports, revives a stopped coder and writes the commit prefix.
* [Calibration and mutation locks move out of the Claude config folder](2026-10-21-calibration-and-mutation-locks-move-out-of-the.md) - The mutation tester and /calibrate write their lock and backups under the XDG state folder, not under ~/.claude. The auto-mode classifier denied writes under ~/.claude, so mutation runs ended INDETERMINATE.
* [The review-loop stop gate writes the reviewer run rows](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-stop-gate-writes-the-reviewer-run.md) - The review-loop stop gate writes one kind=run row for each reviewer the loop dispatched, with the finding count read from the reviewer's report. Before, the loop agent wrote these rows from its own prose, and it skipped or mixed them up.
* [The repeat-check cap counts only checks that ran and sees git changes](2026-10-21-the-repeat-check-cap-counts-only-checks-that-ran.md) - The quality-check cap denies a repeat check only when the earlier run surely ran and the working tree did not change. It sees git merges and commits, never denies a formatter that writes, and lets the review loop's gate run through.
* [The comment-bloat gate reads only comment lines in JSON files](2026-10-21-the-comment-bloat-gate-reads-only-comment-lines-in.md) - The comment-bloat gate no longer reads JSON values as comments. It blocked writes of JSON fixtures and test files that held long string values.
* [Remove the hook that forced agents to run in the foreground](2026-10-21-remove-the-hook-that-forced-agents-to-run-in-the.md) - The PreToolUse hook that set run_in_background to false on every Agent dispatch is gone. It did not hold, and the reason for it no longer exists: a subagent now gets the finish notice of its own background agents.
* [The review-loop gate run drops the repeat-check skip marker](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-gate-run-drops-the-repeat-check.md) - The review loop's Step 6 gate run no longer ends with a skip marker for the repeat-check cap. The auto-mode classifier denied every command that carried the marker, so the gate run never ran. This reverses the 2026-10-20 change.
* [The branch recap writes no receipt, not clean, when the test audit left no receipt](2026-10-21-the-branch-recap-writes-no-receipt-not-clean-when.md) - The recap sheet and the recap telemetry row now say "no receipt" when no /test-audit receipt is in context. Before, the recap wrote "clean" with no audit behind it.
* [The review-loop stop gate lets a stop pass while the loop waits on its own agents](2026-10-21-the-review-loop-stop-gate-lets-a-stop-pass-while.md) - review-loop-gate.py no longer blocks a review loop's stop while one of the loop's background agents has not reported. The loop ends its turn to wait for each report, and the gate read every wait as an attempt to finish.
* [Retire the bash copies of ported hooks and the port workspace](2026-10-21-retire-the-bash-copies-of-ported-hooks-and-the.md) - The installer deletes the bash copy of 20 hooks whose Python port settings.json runs, then deletes the port workspace ~/dev/evals/hookport/. Script prose stops naming the old .sh files.
* [A plan-impact ruling names who made it, and only the user's ruling changes the criteria](2026-10-21-a-plan-impact-ruling-names-who-made-it-and-only.md) - decide adopt|keep needs --by user|session. Only --by user signs with the git user name and lets the plan-edit coder rewrite the acceptance criteria. A session or pre-set ruling edits the plan only, and code-step.py restores the criteria if the coder changes them.

# 2026-10-20

* [The /code routing script runs each dispatch in the background and keeps the run in one session](2026-10-20-the-code-routing-script-runs-each-dispatch-in-the.md) - code-step.py prints a background dispatch and the next verb waits for the agent's report. Hooks store the hand-backs, keep the fork alive while a dispatch is open and print say.md as the closing text. The run pins to one session.
* [One refactor-flow call does the fixed steps of each /refactor mode](2026-10-20-one-refactor-flow-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of.md) - refactor-flow.py has one prep verb per mode, a log verb that writes the escape and finding rows once, and a handoff verb that renders the review hand-off. Each verb ends with a NEXT or STOP line.
* [One adr-flow call does the fixed steps of /adr](2026-10-20-one-adr-flow-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of-adr.md) - adr-flow.py prep resolves the task dir and prints the target path, PR url, sources and template. check validates the draft. finish checks it again and deletes the task dir only when every safety check passes.
* [One branch-base script picks the base branch for review-scope, test-reviewer and refactor](2026-10-20-one-branch-base-script-picks-the-base-branch-for.md) - scripts/branch-base prints the default base ref of a branch and where it came from. review-scope, the test-reviewer branch scope and refactor-flow all call it, so the three no longer choose a base each their own way.
* [The metrics writers run only while the telemetry switch is on](2026-10-20-the-metrics-writers-run-only-while-the-telemetry.md) - Every metrics writer checks one helper first. The switch is on when CLAUDE_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=1 is set or the file ~/.claude/toolkit-telemetry exists. Off, each writer skips its write and exits 0.
* [Review a whole branch with review base=ref](2026-10-20-review-a-whole-branch-with-review-base-ref.md) - `/review base=<ref>` passes a `base: <ref>` input to the review loop, which hands it to review-scope, so one review covers every change since that ref, commits included.
* [The review-loop agent file pins the sonnet model](2026-10-20-the-review-loop-agent-file-pins-the-sonnet-model.md) - `agents/review-loop.md` frontmatter now holds `model: sonnet`, so a dispatch that names no model runs the loop on Sonnet and does not take the model of the session that dispatched it.
* [Run the review-loop execution gate past the repeat-check cap](2026-10-20-run-the-review-loop-execution-gate-past-the-repeat.md) - The review loop's one full quality-check run now carries a trailing `#skip-quality-cap`, so the cap on repeated checks cannot deny the gate that decides convergence.
* [Prescribe toolkit logging calls as plain commands by path](2026-10-20-prescribe-toolkit-logging-calls-as-plain-commands.md) - The review-scope, log-review-finding and log-escape calls in the review loop and eight skills are now one plain command by the script path, with no `bash "$HOME/..."`, variable, array or `$(...)`, because a worktree-isolated session refuses those forms.
* [One review-fix call builds the packet for review and fix](2026-10-20-one-review-fix-call-builds-the-packet-for-review.md) - A hook saves the review loop's hand-back and the commit gate refuses a false clean mark. One review-fix.py call parses it, routes on its status, renders the user text, opens the asks in the editor and logs the rows, so /review and /fix leave the model only the asks and the closing line.
* [One verify-prep call does the fixed steps of verify-branch](2026-10-20-one-verify-prep-call-does-the-fixed-steps-of.md) - verify-prep resolves the task dir, reads the criteria, measures the diff, checks for a branch-wide review since the last change and prints the exact dispatches; verify-log writes the run and gap rows. The Verify pass in /code only invokes /verify-branch, which owns the branch-wide review.
* [One plan grammar with a check at write time, and closing phases after coding phases](2026-10-20-one-plan-grammar-with-a-check-at-write-time-and.md) - code-step reads every plan through one parse function that stops on any line it cannot read, checks a plan when it is written, and runs the closing phases only after every coding phase, so a phase added during a run cannot run after the Verify pass.
* [A small follow-up re-review does not re-send the structure and test reviewers](2026-10-20-a-small-follow-up-re-review-does-not-re-send-the.md) - When /code reviews again after the coder that applies accepted asks, or after a plan ruling, and that coder's own change is small, the review carries `structure-pass: skip` and the review loop sends only the code reviewer.
* [Toolkit script rules: real inputs, one grammar, loud failures](2026-10-20-toolkit-script-rules-real-inputs-one-grammar-loud.md) - One rules file for every toolkit script and draft, loaded by the dotfiles and agent-evals project rules: read the real inputs first, one grammar per format with loud failures, check callers and real hook events, handle changes during a run, and test the draft and the installed copy.
* [One call runs the fixed steps of /stage](2026-10-20-one-call-runs-the-fixed-steps-of-stage.md) - `stage.mjs --run` classifies once, stages the SAFE tier, writes the metrics row and prints the finished report and jump list. The model keeps only the per-entry notes, the nvim-jump call and tier disagreements.
* [Re-review after the asks coder covers only its own diff](2026-10-20-re-review-after-the-asks-coder-covers-only-its-own.md) - After the user rules on review asks and a coder applies them, the next review reads only the files that coder changed. A docs-only asks diff ends the phase with no review.
* [Rename the branch-end completeness skill to verify-branch](2026-10-20-rename-the-branch-end-completeness-skill-to-verify.md) - Claude Code 2.1.304 ships its own skill named verify, and adds the line 'Always run /verify right before the commit command' to the Bash tool instructions when any skill has that name. With the user's skill also named verify, the line sent agents to the branch-end completeness check before each commit. The user's skill is now verify-branch, so the name verify means only Claude Code's skill.
* [Read only review reports saved after the latest review dispatch](2026-10-20-read-only-review-reports-saved-after-the-latest.md) - The /code step machine read an old plan-impact review report again when a later review saved no report. It then asked the plan-change question again, started another review and added another Plan Deviations entry, in a loop that ended only when a reviewer handed back. after-review now reads only reports saved after the latest review dispatch, so a report is acted on once.
* [Run the 19 shell hooks as Python scripts](2026-10-20-run-the-19-shell-hooks-as-python-scripts.md) - 19 hooks written in bash now run as Python scripts with the same decisions and output. batch-reads-nudge points straight at its Python file. At work, each bash hook takes 110–470 ms per call because bash and every program it starts are slow to launch there. Python starts in 13 ms. The predicted cut is about 0.5 s of hook time per Bash call at work.

# 2026-10-19

* [Deny unbounded waits in subagent Bash calls](2026-10-19-deny-unbounded-waits-in-subagent-bash-calls.md) - A new PreToolUse Bash hook denies a subagent's wait that has no time limit: an until or while loop with sleep, a long for loop with sleep, follow-mode log reads, and a sleep over 30 s.
